# GENERATED TREE, do not edit anything in this folder

Every `*.py` under `biosqa/` is a **verbatim byte copy** of the research monorepo's
`src/biosqa/<same path>`. It is regenerated by:

```
python scripts/sync_from_src.py --check    # report drift, exit 1 if any
python scripts/sync_from_src.py            # rewrite from src/biosqa
```

An edit made here is silently reverted by the next sync, and, worse, until then it makes the
published reproduction package disagree with the engine that produced the paper's numbers. That
has already happened twice (see `../README.md`). Fix the monorepo copy instead.

The one deliberate exception is **`utils/paths.py`**: its `REPO_ROOT` must resolve to this
folder, because the package sits at `<root>/biosqa`, one level shallower than `src/biosqa`.
`sync_from_src.py` skips it by name.
